"""Research mechanism probe, not a public API or DSH benchmark; writes fresh /tmp fixture."""
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

repo = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo))
from vtx.render import gfx_render as gfx
from vtx.api import frame_timeline

root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='f363-', dir='/tmp'))
source = repo / 'templates/tech-talk/assets/gfx-templates/chart_curve.html'
page = root / 'chart_curve.html'
shutil.copyfile(source, page)
chrome = '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome'
os.environ.update(VTX_GFX_NAVFREE='0', VTX_GFX_STATIC='1', VTX_GFX_TABS='4')
config = root / 'config.json'
config.write_text('{}')
os.environ['VTX_CONFIG'] = str(config)
summary = {'schema':'framivra.single-frame-research/v1', 'revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], text=True).strip(), 'platform':platform.platform(), 'python':sys.version, 'chrome':subprocess.check_output([chrome,'--version'], text=True).strip(), 'chrome_binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(chrome).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'numpy':gfx.numpy.__version__, 'input':{'path':str(source.relative_to(repo)), 'sha256':hashlib.sha256(page.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'n_frames':600, 'width':1920, 'height':1080, 'fps':30}, 'environment':{k:os.environ[k] for k in ('VTX_GFX_NAVFREE','VTX_GFX_STATIC','VTX_GFX_TABS')}, 'scope':'Internal render_page only; fresh browser per nonempty call; no OS cache flush; local fonts not pinned; raw early-return reuse is NOT authenticated production cache; no timeline composition, DSH transport or GUI benchmark.', 'trials':[]}
original_start, original_stop = gfx.Browser.start, gfx.Browser.stop
original_shot, original_navigate = gfx.Tab.shot, gfx.Tab.navigate

def run(label, directory, frames):
    obs = {'browser_start_ms':[], 'browser_stop_ms':[], 'shot_ms':[], 'navigate_ms':[]}
    def timed(name, original):
        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
            t = time.perf_counter()
            try: return original(*args, **kwargs)
            finally: obs[name].append((time.perf_counter()-t)*1000)
        return wrapper
    t = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        with patch.object(gfx.Browser, 'start', timed('browser_start_ms', original_start)), patch.object(gfx.Browser, 'stop', timed('browser_stop_ms', original_stop)), patch.object(gfx.Tab, 'shot', timed('shot_ms', original_shot)), patch.object(gfx.Tab, 'navigate', timed('navigate_ms', original_navigate)):
            stats = gfx.render_page(str(page), str(directory), 600, chrome_path=chrome, tabs=4, width=1920, height=1080, frames=frames)
        wall = (time.perf_counter()-t)*1000
        images = []
        for f in frames:
            data = (directory / ('f%04d.png' % f)).read_bytes()
            rgba = gfx.png_decode_rgba(data)
            images.append({'frame':f,'png_bytes':len(data),'base64_bytes':len(base64.b64encode(data)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'rgba_sha256':hashlib.sha256(rgba.tobytes()).hexdigest(),'shape':list(rgba.shape)})
        result = {'label':label,'frames':frames,'wall_ms':wall,'stats':stats,'observations':obs,'images':images,'files':sorted(p.name for p in directory.iterdir())}
    except Exception as exc:
        result = {'label':label,'frames':frames,'wall_ms':(time.perf_counter()-t)*1000,'error':type(exc).__name__+': '+str(exc),'observations':obs}
    summary['trials'].append(result)
    (root / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')

for i in range(3):
    directory = root / ('trial-%d' % (i+1))
    run('fresh-%d' % (i+1), directory, [305])
    run('existing-png-%d' % (i+1), directory, [305])
    run('neighbor-%d' % (i+1), directory, [306])
run('ordered-neighbors', root / 'ordered', [304,305,306])
timeline = root / 'timeline.json'
timeline.write_text(json.dumps({'version':2,'project':{'fps':30,'width':1920,'height':1080,'duration_frames':600},'sources':[],'video_tracks':[{'name':'chart','kind':'gfx','clips':[{'src':'chart_curve.html','dst_in':0,'dur':600}]}],'audio_tracks':[],'subtitles':[]}))
before = sorted(p.name for p in root.iterdir())
result = frame_timeline(timeline, frame=305, render=True, include_png=True)
summary['public_frame_probe'] = {'ok':result['ok'],'diagnostics':result['diagnostics'],'new_root_entries':sorted(set(p.name for p in root.iterdir())-set(before))}
summary['probe_source'] = Path(__file__).read_text()
(root / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'root':str(root),'result':str(root/'results.json'),'attempts':len(summary['trials']),'errors':[t['label'] for t in summary['trials'] if 'error' in t],'public_frame_probe':summary['public_frame_probe']}))
if any('error' in t or t['stats']['failed'] for t in summary['trials']):
    raise SystemExit(1)
